facts.fact: The NESG session report of 23 May 2024 names the 'National Digital Economy Policy and Strategy (NDEPS) Implementation Plan 2020-2030' as the plan the Digital Economy Compact serves.
facts.system: National Digital Economy Policy and Strategy 2020-2030

facts.fact: The report says the Digital Economy Compact designates the operational context of NDEPS 2030 to the Digital Economy Industry Working Group, a public-private body inaugurated on 27 October 2022 by the NESG and the Federal Ministry; the compact's date is not given, so the session date is used.
facts.system: National Digital Economy Policy and Strategy 2020-2030

systems.owner: Federal Ministry of Communications and Digital Economy

note: The report names the National Digital Economy Policy and Strategy without describing its scope, so the class is empty for that reason; it states no adoption, text or reporting.
